Name: OneSquare's Topsoil Textures
Author: OneSquareAAT
Description:
[b]OneSquare's Topsoil Texture Pack

[/b]This is an item texture pack that replaces the vanilla icons with my own take on sprites, ranging from farming and mining to forage materials. This mod does not add any content, and instead simply replaces graphics of a variety of vanilla items.

Currently includes:

- Vast majority of crops.
- Most fruit tree fruits.
- Smeltables like all ores, bars, quartz and refined, coal. 
- Vast majority of forages.
- 5 monster exclusive drops.
- Geodes and gemstones. 
- Most artisan goods.
- Animal Products.
- Most Fish!

The mod is configurable.
